b1.goal: Say how you feel — I am hungry, I am tired, I am happy

b2.goal: Introduce your family and the people around you in English

b3.goal: Kitchen and market words — the things you use every day

b4.goal: From morning to night — say everything you do in English

b5.goal: Sky, rain, big and small — describe the world around you

i1.goal: Explain, agree and disagree, complain politely, make promises

i2.goal: Salary, interviews, budgets — the language of working life

i3.goal: From the station to the hotel — every word of a journey

i4.goal: Describe people's character and emotions precisely

i5.goal: Effort, habits, goals — the language of getting things done

a1.goal: Advocate, refute, justify — win an argument with precision

a2.goal: Inequality, infrastructure, welfare — discuss how society works

a3.goal: Stakeholders, liability, term sheets — professional deal-making English

a4.goal: Hypothesis, methodology, correlation — academic and scientific language

a5.goal: Resilient, pragmatic, tenacious — describe people with exact words

why.title: Why this order works
why.point1: Small chunks: 12 words + 1 lesson + 1 story — easy to finish in one sitting
why.point2: Every step builds on the last: the story recycles the exact words you just learned
why.point3: You recall at every step — marking words and taking the story quiz makes it stick

plan.title: Your 4-week plan
plan.subtitle: Built for your level and your goal: {goal}. Follow the weeks — the highlighted one is where you are now.

general.w1: Everyday words & simple sentences — start speaking from day one
general.w2: Ask questions and keep a small conversation alive
general.w3: Talk about your day, plans and opinions
general.w4: Put it all together — stories, reviews and confident chat

job.w1: Workplace words & introductions that sound professional
job.w2: Describe your experience and answer common interview questions
job.w3: Meetings, phone calls and polite workplace requests
job.w4: Full interview rehearsal — plus speaking practice every week

exam.w1: Core exam vocabulary and accurate sentence building
exam.w2: Complex sentences and linking ideas (Part 3 skills)
exam.w4: Timed practice, review and exam-day strategies

travel.w1: Airport, hotel and direction words you'll actually use
travel.w2: Ask for things politely — food, tickets, help
travel.w4: Real conversation flow — small talk with strangers

school.w1: Study words & classroom language from day one
school.w2: Read and understand longer texts with confidence
school.w3: Write and speak about lessons and homework
school.w4: Present ideas clearly — everything comes together
